issues.description: The template and solution differ in the return type of the POST /persons controller method: the template's PersonResource#createPerson returns ResponseEntity<Person> with the saved person, while the solution's PersonResource#createPerson has a void return type and does not return the saved entity. This inconsistency in controller method signature may confuse students about the expected controller contract and what the REST endpoint should return.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the controller method signature consistent across template and solution. Either change the template method to void and perform personService.save(person) (matching the solution), or change the solution to return ResponseEntity<Person> with the saved person (matching the template). Update related tests and documentation accordingly so students have a single expected controller contract.
